about: Certification path planner data. Prices and formats were checked on 14 Oct 2026 from the linked pages (several are third-party and disagree); every figure is marked verify and must be checked on the vendor's own page before you pay. Hours are planning estimates for someone starting from zero, not promises: adjust with --pace.
landed_note: Assumption: +18% GST where a foreign vendor charges it on online services, +3% card forex markup. Some vendors charge no GST; check your invoice. Paid personally (no employer reimbursement), so there is no tax deduction against salary.

network-ad.what: Network + Active Directory penetration testing (the base every red-team cert builds on)
practice: HTB Academy modules and the exam-style labs of each course
./securax range soil, then ./securax range install MINILAB (8 GB, VirtualBox on Windows; not inside WSL)
./securax range snapshot before each session, reset after

web.what: Web application testing and source-code review
practice: PortSwigger Web Security Academy (free): every Apprentice and Practitioner lab before BSCP
read the code of the apps you break: OSWE is a code-review exam
./securax purple: attack your own gateway's guardrails and read the report
HTB Academy AI Red Teamer path
./securax demo: the red-team scorecard against your own rails

htb_silver_annual.name: Hack The Box Academy Silver (annual)
htb_silver_annual.note: Reported to rise from $490 to $550 on 12 Oct 2026 and to include exam voucher(s); the planner still budgets each $210 voucher in case it does not.

offsec_unlimited.name: OffSec Learn Unlimited (annual: all 100-300 courses, unlimited exam attempts, Proving Grounds Practice)
offsec_unlimited.note: Official list price; auto-renews unless cancelled. The planner uses it for the 300-level certs only (OSCP+ stays a single course in year 1, which is cheaper).

certs.name: HTB Certified Penetration Testing Specialist (CPTS)
certs.format: 10-day practical internal pentest incl. Active Directory, plus a professional report
certs.why: First, on purpose: broader AD and reporting than OSCP at a fraction of the price; the Academy path doubles as your foundations (Linux, networking, web basics).

certs.name: Altered Security Certified Red Team Professional (CRTP)
certs.format: Practical Active Directory lab exam (30-day lab with the course; check the vendor for exam details)
certs.why: Cheapest deep Active Directory credential; feeds CRTO, CRTE, OSEP.

certs.name: Burp Suite Certified Practitioner (BSCP)
certs.format: 4-hour practical web exam; valid 5 years; needs Burp Suite Professional
certs.why: Cheapest credible web proof; the free Academy is the best web training there is; base for OSWE.

certs.name: OffSec Certified Professional+ (OSCP+)
certs.format: ~24-hour proctored practical exam + 24-hour report; 70/100 to pass; OSCP+ valid 3 years
certs.why: The name HR filters on. Taken after CPTS it is mostly exam practice, not new learning.

certs.name: HTB Certified Offensive AI Expert (COAE)
certs.why: AI security in BFSI is rare; this is your differentiator, and your own estate is the lab.

certs.name: OffSec AI Red Teamer (OSAI)
certs.format: 24-hour proctored practical against an AI-enabled enterprise + report (launched 31 Mar 2026)
certs.why: The hardest-recognised AI offensive credential today.

certs.name: Zero-Point Security Certified Red Team Operator (CRTO)
certs.format: Practical red-team operation, no report (format changed in 2025; sources disagree on details)
certs.why: Red-team tradecraft and operational security; priced in GBP (£399).

certs.name: OffSec Web Expert (OSWE)
certs.why: The respected web-exploitation expert credential; pairs with your AppSec credibility.

certs.name: OffSec Experienced Penetration Tester (OSEP)
certs.why: Advanced pentest/red team; builds directly on CRTO + OSCP+.

certs.name: Altered Security Certified Red Team Expert (CRTE)
certs.format: Practical multi-forest AD lab exam (30/60/90-day lab options)
certs.why: Enterprise AD depth; cheap for what it proves.

certs.name: Altered Security Certified Red Team Master (CRTM)
certs.format: Practical lab exam on the 'Global Central Bank' range
certs.why: A banking-themed master-level AD range: on-theme for BFSI credibility.

certs.name: OffSec Exploit Developer (OSED)
certs.why: Exploit development; only worth it after the core set (long, narrow).

certs.name: HTB Certified Web Exploitation Specialist (CWES)
certs.why: Overlaps BSCP; take only if you want a second web credential.

certs.name: INE Junior Penetration Tester (eJPT)
certs.why: Skipped by default: CPTS covers it; take only if you want a very early win.

certs.name: GIAC (e.g. GPEN, GXPN, GWAPT) without SANS training
certs.format: Proctored knowledge exam (open book); renewal every 4 years
certs.why: Skipped by default: expensive per credential; take only when a specific role or employer asks for one.
